test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The outcome of the interview will be published by next week.

options.text: The panel will have published the outcome of the interview by the week next.
The panel would have published the outcome of the interview by next week.
The panel was to publish the outcome of the interview by next week.
The panel will publish the outcome of the interview by next week.

solution:
The correct answer is 'The panel will publish the outcome of the interview by next week.'
